definitions.explanation: The ocean between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.

examples.japanese: {大西洋|たいせいよう}を{横断|おうだん}した。
{大西洋|たいせいよう}は{太平洋|たいへいよう}に{次|つ}いで{二番目|にばんめ}に{大|おお}きい{海|うみ}だ。
examples.english: The Atlantic Ocean is the second largest ocean after the Pacific.

examples.japanese: コロンブスは{大西洋|たいせいよう}を{渡|わた}って{新大陸|しんたいりく}に{到達|とうたつ}した。
examples.english: Columbus crossed the Atlantic and reached the New World.

notes:
{大西洋|たいせいよう} literally means 'great western ocean,' named from a Japanese/East Asian perspective where it lies to the west.

ETYMOLOGY:
The kanji {大|たい} (great) + {西|せい} (west) + {洋|よう} (ocean). The name contrasts with {太平洋|たいへいよう} (Pacific Ocean, 'great peaceful ocean'), which uses a different first character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大西洋|たいせいよう}を{横断|おうだん}する: to cross the Atlantic
- {北|きた}{大西洋|たいせいよう}: North Atlantic
- {南|みなみ}{大西洋|たいせいよう}: South Atlantic
- {大西洋|たいせいよう}{沿岸|えんがん}: Atlantic coast

OTHER OCEANS:
- {太平洋|たいへいよう}: Pacific Ocean
- {インド洋|いんどよう}: Indian Ocean
- {北極海|ほっきょくかい}: Arctic Ocean
- {南極海|なんきょくかい}: Southern Ocean
